scope: One authenticated hosted forward request on one real frozen-host window; no phenotype access, fitting or ranking
host_rule: First lexicographically sorted host in frozen manifest; chosen without outcomes. 370D has incomplete panel labels, irrelevant to this engineering-only probe.
selection: First full-length window among the existing canonical-contig, evenly spaced 32-window selection; forward orientation only, no alternate host/window on failure
budget_semantics: Only one POST; socket I/O timeout is not an absolute end-to-end deadline. HTTP 202 is recorded with request ID, never resubmitted. Limits bound one response plus one decoded archive member, not peak process memory.
pooling: After shape/finiteness checks, token mean in float64, persist one float32 8192-vector; do not retain full token tensor or raw source sequence in committed results.
provider_identity: Hosted checkpoint and runtime hashes remain unknown. Never admit this as a local v1 deployment/cache.
next_gate: Measure response size, wall/server time and integrity before a distinct hosted three-host pilot protocol. No automatic expansion to full genomes.
